correctness.rationale: The twisting relation in the maximal-rank normal form forces Y=[A C; 0 zeta A], with A²=0 and AC+zeta CA=0. If A has rank j, choose U=im A and a complementary j-space T mapping isomorphically onto U, and an h=r-2j dimensional homology summand H. The equation forces C[T,U], C[T,H] and C[H,U] to vanish and C[T,T]=-zeta C[U,U]. The remaining blocks apart from C[H,H] give 2j²+2jh independent field coordinates. Projecting im Y to the lower block gives dimension j and kernel of dimension dim(im A + C(ker A))=j+rank(C[H,H]); thus rank Y=2j+rank(C[H,H]). Counting image, kernel and induced isomorphism proves each Gaussian factor, also the prefactor for varying X. The reasoning needs only zeta invertible, so includes characteristic two, r=1, zero rank and extension fields. Independently enumerated eight bounded cases with /workspace/branches/bb6cd006-848a-4453-b0da-c8c11ea5dd3c/count_check.py; for r=2 the F3 and F4 counts were (1,32,120) and (1,75,420) for every nonzero twist. The supplied verifier was inspected, not executed. These finite cases corroborate the proof, not its full quantifier.
